## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Manchester, United Kingdom. It starts at Lower Byrom Street.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Gather your group for the Crystal Maze Live Experience. Friends, family, and colleagues can join in the fun. Choose from four challenges: Mental, Physical, Mystery, and Skill. Each player will face a 2-3 minute challenge against the clock. Every challenge conquered earns the team a crystal.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €59.26. It was rated 5.0 out of 5 from 2 ratings and 2 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
